audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer had Lissandra winning all seven rows while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Zed on all seven. Worse, every full-layer why under those Lissandra-side rows described Zed's own poke pattern — the row said one thing and the sentence under it said the opposite, on all seven rows.
audit.why: Lissandra has no dash until Glacial Path at 3 (24s at rank 1), no sustain, and one dodgeable line poke; the content layer's whys, spikes and early/mid/late all describe a Zed-favoured lane, and the 50.31% win rate over 6305 games supports an even-to-Zed lane, not a 7/10-to-8/10 loss on every stage.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side Lissandra->Zed as one atomic group, with all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal to state the Zed verdict and carry a real number. No win[N] edits: the content layer already read Zed on every row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup — Frozen Tomb self-cast beating Death Mark — appeared only as a vague 'she self-tombs your mark' in the tldr and 'force her to Zhonya-tomb' in spikes[1].text, which mixes an item name into an ability.
audit.why: Riot R text: 'If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable.' Death Mark waits 3 seconds before it triggers, so a 120/100/80s self-tomb spent inside that window is the whole counterplay.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeBad, breakdown.carry, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text now state untargetable-and-invulnerable against the 3-second wait, with the 120s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD, diffRating 8/10 and carryRating 8.5/10 sit against a 50.31% win rate and a level chart that (in both the packet and the content layer) gives Zed every stage.
audit.why: The rating and the chart cannot both be right. I could not resolve which from the kit alone — Frozen Tomb genuinely answers Death Mark, which is a real reason to rate the matchup hard even in a lane Zed wins.
audit.corrected: Left diff, diffRating, carryRating, tone and breakdown.difficulty untouched and raised it as a question rather than guess. The chart itself was fixed because two sources agree on it.

audit.why: Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12s at 1050 range; Ring of Frost 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at only 450 range; Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with all three; the 450 root radius is now the spacing rule in breakdown.early too.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, despite Frozen Tomb healing her.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal; Riot R text: 'she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Iceborn Subjugation was never mentioned — a champion dying near her becomes a Frozen Thrall that slows and then shatters.
audit.why: Riot passive text. It makes fighting over a fresh corpse in her range materially worse, which is exactly what a post-mark Zed does.

notes: This matchup was the worst chart case in the slice: all seven full-layer rows said Lissandra while all seven content win[] rows and the whole packet chart said Zed, and every full-layer why under those Lissandra rows was actually describing Zed's poke pattern. Flipped all seven sides to Zed as one atomic group and rewrote every why. I did NOT touch diff (HARD), diffRating (8/10), carryRating (8.5/10), tone or breakdown.difficulty — see questionsForUser: an 8/10 HARD rating cannot coexist with a 50.31% win rate and an all-Zed chart, but Frozen Tomb genuinely answers Death Mark, so I would not guess which the user wants. spikes[1].text had 'force her to Zhonya-tomb', mixing an item name into an ability; Frozen Tomb is untargetable and invulnerable per Riot's own text and is now described that way.
